# pidginhost_bucket_credentials (Ephemeral Resource)

The current S3 access key and secret key of a bucket, read on every plan and apply and never saved in the Terraform state. Reading them does not rotate them, but the API records every read in an audit trail. Rotate keys with the pidginhost_bucket_credentials resource. Needs Terraform 1.10 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "pidginhost_bucket_credentials" "media" {
  bucket_id = var.bucket_id
}

# An S3 client configured without saving the keys in the state.
provider "aws" {
  region     = "us-east-1"
  access_key = ephemeral.pidginhost_bucket_credentials.media.access_key
  secret_key = ephemeral.pidginhost_bucket_credentials.media.secret_key

  endpoints {
    s3 = var.bucket_endpoint
  }
  s3_use_path_style           = true
  skip_credentials_validation = true
  skip_region_validation      = true
  skip_requesting_account_id  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_id` (String) Id of the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret key.
